source: Wolfspeed press release: Wolfspeed Expands 200 mm Silicon Carbide Portfolio with New (09-27-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Wolfspeed announced commercial availability of its Premium 200 mm n-type silicon carbide substrate, a higher-quality starting material for SiC device makers: fewer than 0.01 micropipes per square centimeter (fewer than three micropipes per wafer, validated by X-ray topography) and low threading screw dislocations, aimed at better yield within customers' existing epitaxy processes. The product is orderable now, with dedicated capacity and a product expansion roadmap; Wolfspeed says it can quickly ramp new capacity as demand grows within its established large-scale SiC manufacturing facility, and its 200 mm operations have been in continuous production since 2022. Dr. Cengiz Balkas, EVP, Materials Business Unit: 'We're giving customers a stronger foundation for developing increasingly demanding silicon carbide devices'.
quarterly_data.figure: fewer than 0.01 micropipes per square centimeter; fewer than three micropipes per wafer; available now
